ruling: gorge leaves the MustAttack creature undeclared at the pending declare-attackers decision and offers its attacker option with attack_required=true; the declaration is the active player's act. XMage's engine force-declares and taps an Attacks-each-combat creature when it ENTERS DECLARE_ATTACKERS (checkAttackRequirements before selectAttackers), so its snapshot already shows it tapped attacking before any declaration command runs. XMage's engine artifact, not a gorge defect.
